prompt: Portal must refuse to start without real authentication. When no authentication profile (auth, ldap or oidc) is active and no custom SSO is configured, Portal falls back to the placeholder `DefaultUserInfoHolder` and every request runs as a fixed fake user. Add a startup check in `AuthConfiguration`: once all singletons are initialised (also when lazy initialisation is enabled), fail startup with an `IllegalStateException` explaining that authentication is not configured if the active `UserInfoHolder` is the `DefaultUserInfoHolder`. Built-in authentication and custom SSO implementations (a custom `UserInfoHolder` bean) must keep working.

oracle_plan.instruction: Add a non-lazy SmartInitializingSingleton @Bean that throws IllegalStateException when the injected UserInfoHolder is a DefaultUserInfoHolder.
